def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # simple pursuit: turn toward enemy and go forward
    bearing = me.bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    # clamp turning to reasonable amount
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 45.0))  # 45 deg -> full turn
    # forward throttle
    throttle = 0.9
    left = throttle + turn
    right = throttle - turn
    # clamp to [-1,1]
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # keep front spinner at max rpm
    return spin('front', 5000)

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Always drive toward the enemy with full throttle.
    # Compute bearing to enemy (-180..180, positive left).
    bearing = bearing_to(enemy.x, enemy.y)
    # Turn aggressively: full differential when bearing > 45 deg.
    turn = max(-1.0, min(1.0, bearing / 45.0))
    # Forward component toward enemy.
    # If enemy is behind (|bearing| > 90) drive backwards.
    if abs(bearing) > 90.0:
        throttle = -1.0
    else:
        throttle = 1.0
    left = throttle + turn
    right = throttle - turn
    # Clamp to [-1,1]
    left = max(-1.0, min(1.0, left))
    right = max(-1.0, min(1.0, right))
    return (left, right)

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # Keep the front vertical spinner at max rpm.
    return spin('front', 5000)
